# git compatibility — `org.ono.compat.git`

Version `0.1.0`; process.exec executables: `git`. Everything below is the pack's contract; an invocation not listed under an adapter runs raw, and the limits state what the adapted form does not carry.

## git-status — `org.ono.compat.git.git-status`

Working-tree status as `ono.git-status-entry/1` records, from `git status --porcelain=v2 -z`.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `git` |
| versions | `>=2.11` |
| tier | B — stable machine-readable format |
| schema | `ono.git-status-entry/1` |
| decoder | `git-status-v2` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `git/git-status` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `git status [-uall\|-uno\|-unormal] [--ignored] [pathspec …]` | `git status --porcelain=v2 -z --untracked-files=all` | `-uall`, `-uno`, `-unormal`, `--ignored`, `--no-renames`, `--renames`, `--untracked-files <value>`, `-C <value>` | — |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `index` | `index` |
| `original_path` | `original_path` |
| `path` | `path` |
| `state` | `state` |
| `submodule` | `submodule` |
| `worktree` | `worktree` |

### Limits

- `-s`, `--short`, `-b`, `--branch`, `--long`, `--porcelain` and `-v` choose a human format and run raw; the branch header of porcelain v2 is not a record.
- Unmerged paths are reported with `index`/`worktree` as git's conflict letters and `state: unmerged`.

## git-log — `org.ono.compat.git.git-log`

History as `ono.commit/1` records, from `git log` with an explicit NUL-separated format.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `git` |
| versions | `>=2.11` |
| tier | B — stable machine-readable format |
| schema | `ono.commit/1` |
| decoder | `lines` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `git/git-log` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `git log [-n <count>] [--since <time>] [--until <time>] [--author <pattern>] [--grep <pattern>] [--all] [--merges\|--no-merges] [--first-parent] [<revision …>] [-- <path …>]` | `git log --format=%H%x00%h%x00%an%x00%ae%x00%aI%x00%cn%x00%cI%x00%s%x00%P%x1e` | `--all`, `--merges`, `--no-merges`, `--first-parent`, `--reverse`, `--no-decorate`, `--`, `-n <value>`, `--max-count <value>`, `--since <value>`, `--until <value>`, `--after <value>`, `--before <value>`, `--author <value>`, `--committer <value>`, `--grep <value>`, `--skip <value>` | — |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `author` | `author` |
| `author_email` | `author_email` |
| `authored` | `authored` |
| `committed` | `committed` |
| `committer` | `committer` |
| `hash` | `hash` |
| `parents` | `parents` |
| `short_hash` | `short_hash` |
| `subject` | `subject` |

### Limits

- `-p`, `--stat`, `--oneline`, `--graph`, `--format` and `--pretty` choose the output and run raw.
- `author` and `committer` are flat fields (`author_email`), not nested records.
